title: chelonopsis yaoshanensis
intro: Chelonopsis yaoshanensis, commonly known as Yaoshan Chelonopsis or Yaoshan Snake Root, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chelonopsis yaoshanensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and aid in digestion, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including iridoids and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential interactions of this plant, but it is often used in herbal remedies to promote overall well-being.
